changes.comment: Load plugins from an optional top-level `plugins[]` in `config.json` (`builtin:<id>` or `npm:<package>[#export]` refs, each a string or `{ ref, config }`); existing configs load unchanged. Plugins can contribute providers addressed as `builtin:<name>`, append instructions and skill roots to Dispatcher and TeamLeader launches, and react to Team creation; a failing plugin hook is logged and skipped. `dreamux doctor` lists loaded plugins and plugin load failures. Ships the built-in, opt-in `builtin:bootstrap` plugin, which injects `.workspace/identity.md` and `user.md` from the Dispatcher cwd.
